title: Corn and Egg Bowl
steps: Cut the corn from the cob.
Cook the corn in a pan for 5 minutes.
Add two beaten eggs and stir until cooked.

title: Sweet Potato Egg Bowl
steps: Cut the sweet potato into small pieces.
Microwave it with a spoon of water until soft.
Cook one egg and serve it on top.

title: Potato and Capsicum Hash
steps: Cut the cooked potato and capsicum into small pieces.
Cook them in a pan until warm and lightly brown.
Season and serve.

title: Spinach Omelette
steps: Cook the spinach in a pan until soft.
Pour in two beaten eggs.
Fold the omelette when the egg is cooked.

title: Avocado Egg Toast
steps: Toast two slices of bread.
Mash half an avocado onto the toast.
Add one cooked egg on top.

title: Quick Corn Potato Bowl
steps: Cut the cooked potato into pieces.
Warm the potato and corn in a pan.
Mix together and season.

title: Tomato and Egg Bowl
steps: Cut the tomato into small pieces.
Cook the tomato for 3 minutes.
Add two beaten eggs and stir until cooked.

title: Avocado Potato Plate
steps: Slice the cooked potato.
Add sliced avocado.
Season lightly and serve.
